headline: El Al Reports Higher Revenue and Lower Profit Following Stake Write-Down
summary: El Al Israel Airlines posted higher revenue but lower profit in its latest period, weighed down by a write-down on the value of its stake in credit card firm ICC-CAL after a canceled sale deal.
why: Airline profitability can be impacted by non-operating asset write-downs and equity investments alongside core passenger revenue.

impacts.name: El Al Israel Airlines Ltd.
impacts.why: Accounting write-downs on equity stakes reduce net profit figures despite higher operating revenue.
